correctness.rationale: The rates in assigned RESULT.md b20a4ed9f90dedc5ac8324088b71de68f3310062 match the explicitly described global clock with replacement. Detailed balance w_(k+1)/w_k=λ_k/μ_(k+1) with w_k=binom(S,k)^(1-q). Multiplying backward differences by w_k λ_k telescopes to exact finite mean; the prefix sum of inverse binomial powers is 1+O(1/S) uniformly for k<S. The outer sum localizes near S/2 and the standard central Gaussian integral of binom(S,k)^(q-1) supplies constant 2^(q+1)(2/pi)^((q-2)/2)/sqrt(q-1), power S^(-(q-2)/2), exponential 2^((q-1)S). Independently recomputed small exact first-passage sums for q=2,3 and S=10,20,40; ratios trend to 1. Such finite evidence is not a proof of the asymptotic.
residual_risks: q must be fixed as S→∞; clock normalization rate-one globally; no claim for q growing with S or zealot density bounded below.
